user.title: Smart meter
user.description: Connect the meter's customer interface (IR reading head, M-Bus or P1 adapter) to this Home Assistant host. Stop the Smartmeter add-on first if it uses the same port. Checking the connection can take up to 30 seconds.

data_description.key: 32 hex characters, sent to you by your grid operator.
data_description.interface_type: Only used for Burgenland and Wien.

migrate.title: Take over add-on sensors
migrate.description:
Found the Smartmeter add-on device **{device}** with {count} sensors that match this meter. Taking them over keeps their entity ids, names, areas and history, so dashboards, automations and the energy dashboard keep working. The add-on device and its entities are removed.

Stop the add-on and disable its autostart first, otherwise it recreates its sensors.

data_description.migrate: Without taking them over, the integration creates new sensors and the add-on sensors stay as they are.

error.invalid_key: The key must be exactly 32 hex characters.
error.port_in_use: This port is already used by another smart meter entry.
error.cannot_connect: The serial port cannot be opened.
error.no_data: No valid telegram received. Check the key, the meter type, the reading head position and that the customer interface is activated.
error.addon_running: The add-on still reports values. Stop the add-on, wait a minute and try again.

abort.core_unavailable: The Smartmeter core could not be loaded, see the log.

data_description.update_interval: Seconds between entity updates. The meter sends every 1-10 seconds; lower values write more to the database.
data_description.migrate: Gives this entry's sensors the entity ids and settings of the Smartmeter add-on sensors, so dashboards, automations and statistics keep working. The sensors this entry created so far are replaced. Stop the add-on and disable its autostart first.

error.addon_running: The add-on still reports values. Stop the add-on, wait a minute and try again.

options.wien: Wiener Netze (Siemens IM150/IM350/IM351, Iskraemeco AM550, Landis+Gyr E450)
